texts: RTS 2024/1774 — article 16 : acquisition, développement et maintenance des systèmes TIC
Politique interne PDS-2 (Banque Kerlann, fictive) — développement sécurisé

requirements.quote: financial entities shall develop, document and implement a policy governing the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems.
requirements.summary: Requires a documented policy for ICT systems acquisition, development and maintenance.
requirements.why: Requires review of a governance policy document not visible via the read-only code repository API.

requirements.quote: identify security practices and methodologies relating to the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems;
requirements.summary: Policy must identify security practices and methodologies for acquisition, development and maintenance.
requirements.why: Requires review of policy content not visible via the read-only code repository API.

requirements.quote: specify measures to mitigate the risk of unintentional alteration or intentional manipulation of the ICT systems during development, maintenance, and deployment.
requirements.summary: Policy must specify measures against unintentional alteration or intentional manipulation during development and deployment.
requirements.why: Requires review of policy content not visible via the read-only code repository API.

requirements.quote: financial entities shall develop, document, and implement an ICT systems' acquisition, development, and maintenance procedure for the testing and approval of all ICT systems prior to their use and after maintenance.
requirements.summary: Requires a documented procedure for testing and approval of ICT systems before use and after maintenance.
requirements.why: Requires review of a procedure document and approval records not visible via the read-only code repository API.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall contain source code reviews covering both static and dynamic testing, including security testing for internet-exposed systems and applications.
requirements.summary: Procedure must include source code reviews with static and dynamic testing including security testing.
requirements.why: Implementation is verifiable in CI configuration via the read-only repository API through covering policy rule PDS-2.4.

requirements.quote: identify and analyse vulnerabilities and anomalies in the source code;
requirements.summary: Requires identification and analysis of vulnerabilities and anomalies in source code.
requirements.why: Requires review of vulnerability analysis reports and action plans not visible via the read-only code repository API.

requirements.quote: adopt an action plan to address those vulnerabilities and anomalies;
requirements.summary: Requires adoption of an action plan to address identified vulnerabilities and anomalies.
requirements.why: Requires review of remediation action plans not visible via the read-only code repository API.

requirements.quote: monitor the implementation of that action plan.
requirements.summary: Requires monitoring of the implementation of the vulnerability action plan.
requirements.why: Requires review of follow-up and monitoring evidence not visible via the read-only code repository API.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall contain security testing of software packages no later than at the integration phase.
requirements.summary: Procedure must include security testing of software packages no later than integration phase.
requirements.why: Implementation is verifiable in CI and dependency configuration via the read-only repository API through covering policy rule PDS-2.5.

requirements.quote: non-production environments only store anonymised, pseudonymised, or randomised production data;
requirements.summary: Non-production environments may only store anonymised, pseudonymised or randomised production data.
requirements.why: Implementation is verifiable in test fixtures via the read-only repository API through covering policy rule PDS-2.6.

requirements.quote: financial entities are to protect the integrity and confidentiality of data in non-production environments.
requirements.summary: Integrity and confidentiality of data in non-production environments must be protected.
requirements.why: Requires review of data protection measures for non-production environments not provable by code search alone.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall include controls to protect the integrity of source code of ICT systems that are developed in-house or by an ICT third-party service provider.
requirements.summary: Procedure must include controls to protect integrity of source code developed in-house or by providers.
requirements.why: Requires review of source-code integrity controls and repository settings not visible via the read-only file content API.

requirements.quote: proprietary software and, where feasible, the source code provided by ICT third-party service providers, as well as source code coming from open-source projects, are to be analysed and tested in accordance with paragraph 3 prior to their deployment in the production environment.
requirements.summary: Third-party and open-source software must be analysed and tested per paragraph 3 before production deployment.
requirements.why: Implementation is verifiable in CI dependency audit configuration via the read-only repository API through covering policy rule PDS-2.5.

requirements.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.
requirements.summary: No secrets in clear text in source or versioned config; secrets come from vault or environment variables.
requirements.why: Verifiable by listing files and searching code for hardcoded secrets via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: No hardcoded secrets in code or versioned configuration
controls.objective: Verify no passwords, keys or tokens are hardcoded in clear text and secrets are sourced from vault or environment variables.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(?i)(password|passwd|secret|api[_-]?key|token)\s*[:=] to find secret assignments, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> for matches to confirm values come from os.environ, os.getenv or vault client and no clear-text value is present.
controls.expected: Zero hardcoded clear-text secrets; all secret usages reference vault or environment variables.
controls.risk: Hardcoded secrets allow credential theft and unauthorized access to the SEPA transfer service.
controls.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets and source them from vault or environment variables.
controls.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.

requirements.quote: Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit).
requirements.summary: All outgoing network calls must verify server TLS certificate with verification never disabled.
requirements.why: Verifiable by searching code for disabled TLS verification via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: TLS certificate verification never disabled
controls.objective: Verify outgoing network calls verify TLS certificates and verify=False is absent.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=verify\s*=\s*False to find disabled verification, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=requests\.|urllib|httpx|http\.client to enumerate outgoing calls, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to confirm TLS verification is enabled.
controls.expected: Zero occurrences of verify=False or equivalent TLS verification bypass.
controls.risk: Disabled TLS verification exposes SEPA transfers to interception and man-in-the-middle attacks.
controls.recommendation: Enable TLS certificate verification on all outgoing calls and remove any verify=False.
controls.quote: Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit).

requirements.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.
requirements.summary: Passwords must be hashed with argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2; MD5 and SHA-1 are forbidden for security uses.
requirements.why: Verifiable by searching code for hashing primitives via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: Approved password hashing and ban of MD5/SHA-1
controls.objective: Verify password hashing uses only approved functions and MD5/SHA-1 are not used for security.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(argon2|bcrypt|scrypt|pbkdf2) and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(md5|sha1|hashlib\.(md5|sha1)) to inventory hashing uses, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to confirm password hashing uses an allowed algorithm and MD5/SHA-1 are absent from security contexts.
controls.expected: Password hashing uses argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 only; zero MD5 or SHA-1 uses for security.
controls.risk: Weak hashes allow password recovery and authentication bypass.
controls.recommendation: Replace MD5/SHA-1 with argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 for all password hashing.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

requirements.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.
requirements.summary: CI pipeline must run static security analysis with bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on each change.
requirements.why: Verifiable by inspecting CI workflow files via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: Static security analysis in CI on each change
controls.objective: Verify CI runs bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on each modification.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list .github/workflows files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(bandit|semgrep|codeql) to find analyser invocations, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/<file> to confirm the job runs on push/pull_request for every change.
controls.expected: CI workflow contains bandit or semgrep or CodeQL execution triggered on each modification.
controls.risk: Missing static analysis leaves code vulnerabilities undetected before deployment.
controls.recommendation: Add bandit, semgrep or CodeQL to the CI pipeline on every change.
controls.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.

requirements.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).
requirements.summary: Dependencies must be pinned to exact versions and audited in CI with pip-audit or equivalent.
requirements.why: Verifiable by inspecting requirements file and CI workflows via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: Exact dependency pinning and CI audit
controls.objective: Verify dependencies are pinned with == and audited in CI with pip-audit or equivalent.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to locate requirements.txt and .github/workflows files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=requirements.txt to verify each line uses == exact pinning, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(pip-audit|pip_audit|safety|dependabot) to verify audit in CI, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/<file> to confirm the audit step.
controls.expected: All requirements use paquet==version exact pinning; CI runs pip-audit or equivalent.
controls.risk: Unpinned or unaudited dependencies allow vulnerable packages into production.
controls.recommendation: Pin all dependencies with == and add pip-audit or equivalent to CI.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

requirements.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.
requirements.summary: Test data must be synthetic declared with synthetic true and no production export versioned.
requirements.why: Verifiable by inspecting test fixtures for synthetic marking via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: Synthetic test data only
controls.objective: Verify test data is declared synthetic and no production export is versioned.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list tests/ fixtures, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=synthetic to find synthetic declarations, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<fixture> to confirm presence of "synthetic": true and absence of production data exports.
controls.expected: Test data files contain "synthetic": true; zero versioned production exports.
controls.risk: Production data in test fixtures causes data leakage and non-compliance.
controls.recommendation: Replace test data with synthetic data marked "synthetic": true and remove production exports.
controls.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.

requirements.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
requirements.summary: Application must log authentication successes and failures.
requirements.why: Verifiable by searching application code for authentication logging via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: Logging of authentication successes and failures
controls.objective: Verify the application logs both successful and failed authentication events.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list app/ files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(login|auth|authenticate) and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(log|logger|logging) to find auth logging, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to confirm both success and failure paths emit a log record.
controls.expected: Code contains log statements on both authentication success and authentication failure paths.
controls.risk: Missing auth logs prevent detection of brute-force and account takeover.
controls.recommendation: Add logging for both successful and failed authentication attempts.
controls.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
